english.title: Pull down / obliterate a traffic sign / milestone / direction post on / over a highway - Highways Act 1980
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or excuse,

(A)_[pulled down]_
(B)_[obliterated]_

(C)_[a traffic sign,]_
(D)_[a milestone,]_
(E)_[a direction post,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE SIGN / STONE / POST..), placed on or over a highway, namely **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 131(2) and (3) of the Highways Act 1980.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) It is a defence in any proceedings under section 131(2) above to show that the traffic sign, milestone or post was not lawfully so placed.
(ii) This offence is as amended by sections 35, 38 and 46 of the Criminal Justice Act 1982.
